|errata_history=This is the original release of [[Death Star: Hangar 327]] (version 2 of 4). The image here is the Players Committee card image published 23 June 2021. Every published image that differs visibly from the one before is a version (Bill, 12 November 2026); the <code>hires</code> PNG and <code>large</code> GIF copies of one date are one publication.
* '''Playtest''' ([[Death Star: Hangar 327 (Playtest)]]): Card image published 22 June 2021<ref name="img-Playtest">Players Committee card image as published: <code>Virtual15-Light/large/death_star_hanger_327.gif</code> ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/7df3091df9d13149ec8100ab0d8c2b838567a2a7/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual15-Light/large/death_star_hanger_327.gif holotable commit 7df3091], 22 June 2021); <code>Virtual15-Light/hires/death_star_hanger_327.png</code> ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/ee4c4cd8bccdd1870eb7593e38093132a51fe2c4/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual15-Light/hires/death_star_hanger_327.png holotable commit ee4c4cd], 22 June 2021); <code>Virtual15-Light/hires/deathstarhanger327.png</code> ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/30816d1eceffdd0a07a5af277fcbcbc9fc96f665/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual15-Light/hires/deathstarhanger327.png holotable commit 30816d1], 22 June 2021); <code>Virtual15-Light/large/deathstarhanger327.gif</code> ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/30816d1eceffdd0a07a5af277fcbcbc9fc96f665/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual15-Light/large/deathstarhanger327.gif holotable commit 30816d1], 22 June 2021) (the PC's card-image repository, which serves res.starwarsccg.org/cards; <code>hires</code> PNG and <code>large</code> GIF copies of the same publication).</ref>: “Light: While Obi-Wan alone here, he is immune to attrition. Dark: While Obi-Wan alone here, Vader may not Force drain on Death Star.” Playtest image: uploaded on 22 June 2021, the evening before the set's official release (23 June 2021), and replaced on release day. The card is stored upright (portrait: PNG 703×980; GIF 745×1039, holotable 7df3091; files then named “death_star_hanger_327”); the same day the files were renamed (holotable 30816d1, “filename fixes”, same image). Words as on the released card.
* '''Original''' (this page): Card image published 23 June 2021<ref name="img-Original">Players Committee card image as published: <code>Virtual15-Light/large/deathstarhanger327.gif</code> ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/9319460b36d9e7accecf0d32799fc84256802ef7/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual15-Light/large/deathstarhanger327.gif holotable commit 9319460], 23 June 2021); <code>Virtual15-Light/hires/deathstarhanger327.png</code> ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/9319460b36d9e7accecf0d32799fc84256802ef7/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual15-Light/hires/deathstarhanger327.png holotable commit 9319460], 23 June 2021); <code>Virtual15-Light/hires/deathstarhangar327.png</code> ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/8dac0c4868173f955db42d9c949e82cfad7e6b35/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual15-Light/hires/deathstarhangar327.png holotable commit 8dac0c4], 23 June 2021); <code>Virtual15-Light/large/deathstarhangar327.gif</code> ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/8dac0c4868173f955db42d9c949e82cfad7e6b35/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual15-Light/large/deathstarhangar327.gif holotable commit 8dac0c4], 23 June 2021) (the PC's card-image repository, which serves res.starwarsccg.org/cards; <code>hires</code> PNG and <code>large</code> GIF copies of the same publication).</ref>: “Light: While Obi-Wan alone here, he is immune to attrition. Dark: While Obi-Wan alone here, Vader may not Force drain on Death Star.” '''What changed:''' Virtual Set 15 release (23 June 2021): the PC re-uploaded the card turned 90° to landscape, the way location cards are shown (holotable 9319460, “fixing rotation on v15”: PNG 980×703, GIF 745×534). Same image, words and layout as the playtest upload apart from the orientation. Every published image that differs from the one before is a version (Bill, 12 November 2026). Later the same day the file name was corrected from “hanger” to “hangar” (holotable 8dac0c4, “fixing spelling error on hangar”); the image is identical.
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Death Star: Hangar 327 (Errata)]]): Card image published 21 April 2022<ref name="img-PC-E1">Players Committee card image as published: <code>Virtual15-Light/large/deathstarhangar327.gif</code> ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/3f7288d580f892a638c6e3b78ca43474ade7756a/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual15-Light/large/deathstarhangar327.gif holotable commit 3f7288d], 21 April 2022); <code>Virtual15-Light/hires/deathstarhangar327.png</code> ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/2640d508acff17553640735ee7a15ad93fa78a65/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual15-Light/hires/deathstarhangar327.png holotable commit 2640d50], 20 April 2022) (the PC's card-image repository, which serves res.starwarsccg.org/cards; <code>hires</code> PNG and <code>large</code> GIF copies of the same publication).</ref>: “Light: While Obi-Wan alone here, he is immune to attrition. Dark: While Obi-Wan alone here, Vader may not Force drain on Death Star.” '''Errata mark:''' this image prints no errata mark but is errata 1 in release order; recorded as printed and listed as a [[Players Committee transcription errors|PC transcription error]] (Bill, 12 November 2026). '''What changed:''' The PC re-rendered the card from a new high-resolution master (holotable 2640d50, “Set 18 and errata”, 20 April 2022: PNG now 1039×745; the GIF copy, holotable 3f7288d, 21 April 2022, stays 745×534), so art, frame, icons and text all render slightly differently. Most visibly: the line down the right border “Artwork not affiliated or endorsed by Lucasfilm Ltd” became “ARTWORK NEITHER AFFILIATED WITH NOR ENDORSED BY LUCASFILM LTD.” in small capitals; the art credit now ends “@ ArtStation” (was “@ ArtStation.com”). Words unchanged.
* '''PC-E2''' ([[Death Star: Hangar 327 (Errata 2)]]): Card image published 11 June 2022 (current; the image the PC card data uses)<ref name="img-PC-E2">Players Committee card image as published: <code>Virtual15-Light/large/deathstarhangar327.gif</code> ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/6894629d2267392808e0be34eb4aaa7686eced2c/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual15-Light/large/deathstarhangar327.gif holotable commit 6894629], 11 June 2022) (the PC's card-image repository, which serves res.starwarsccg.org/cards; <code>hires</code> PNG and <code>large</code> GIF copies of the same publication).</ref>: “Light: While Obi-Wan alone here, he is immune to attrition. Dark: While Obi-Wan alone here, Vader may not Force drain on Death Star.” '''Errata mark:''' this image prints no errata mark but is errata 2 in release order; recorded as printed and listed as a [[Players Committee transcription errors|PC transcription error]] (Bill, 12 November 2026). '''What changed:''' The PC re-made the GIF copy (the file the PC card data uses) at a larger size, 745×534 → 1039×745 pixels, with its new GIF maker (holotable commit 6894629, “updated gif maker so that the landscape images are resized appropriately”, 11 June 2022, which re-made the landscape GIFs of Virtual Sets 4 and 14–18 and 11 alternate-image cards; the new file is PNG data kept under the <code>.gif</code> name). It is the same card enlarged — words, art, layout and errata mark are unchanged; the new GIF is pixel-for-pixel the high-resolution PNG copy the PC had published on 20 April 2022 (<code>Virtual15-Light/hires/deathstarhangar327.png</code>), which until then appeared only in the <code>hires</code> folder. A visible (resolution) change of the card image, so a version (Bill, 12 November 2026: re-renders and resolution changes are versions).
